title: Stock updates: the missing back-in-stock webhook

tasks.text: Support ticket #6630 (a merchant): "We listen for PRODUCT_VARIANT_BACK_IN_STOCK to email waiting customers. A variant had 5 in stock; two orders allocated all 5, and we got OUT_OF_STOCK. Then we restocked to 15 with productVariantStocksUpdate. BACK_IN_STOCK never came. If we set the stock to 0 first and then to 15, it does." Find the cause.

options.text: update_or_create_variant_stocks: the condition that sends product_variant_back_in_stock
update_or_create_variant_stocks: bulk_update saves only the quantity column
Stock.increase_stock: adds to quantity with an F expression
ProductVariantStocksUpdate.perform_mutation: loads the warehouses for the input

parts.prompt: Why is no webhook sent in the merchant's sequence?

options.text: The lambda passed to on_commit captures stock late, so the webhook goes out for a different stock.
bulk_update writes only quantity, so quantity_allocated is reset to 0 and the variant looks in stock already.
The check compares the stored quantity (5) with zero and ignores the 5 allocated units, so the variant never counts as out of stock and the restock to 15 is not seen as coming back.
get_or_create creates a new Stock row for the update, so is_created is True and the webhook is skipped.
Fire whenever the quantity goes up
options.diff:
--- a/saleor/graphql/product/bulk_mutations/products.py
+++ b/saleor/graphql/product/bulk_mutations/products.py
@@ update_or_create_variant_stocks
-            if is_created or (stock.quantity <= 0 and stock_data["quantity"] > 0):
+            if is_created or stock_data["quantity"] > stock.quantity:

options.text: Compare the new quantity with the allocated units
options.diff:
--- a/saleor/graphql/product/bulk_mutations/products.py
+++ b/saleor/graphql/product/bulk_mutations/products.py
@@ update_or_create_variant_stocks
-            if is_created or (stock.quantity <= 0 and stock_data["quantity"] > 0):
+            if is_created or (stock.quantity <= 0 and stock_data["quantity"] > stock.quantity_allocated):

options.text: Use available stock (quantity minus allocated) on both checks
options.diff:
--- a/saleor/graphql/product/bulk_mutations/products.py
+++ b/saleor/graphql/product/bulk_mutations/products.py
@@ update_or_create_variant_stocks
-
-            if is_created or (stock.quantity <= 0 and stock_data["quantity"] > 0):
+            if is_created or (
+                (stock.quantity - stock.quantity_allocated)
+                <= 0
+                < stock_data["quantity"]
+            ):
                 transaction.on_commit(
                     lambda: manager.product_variant_back_in_stock(stock)
                 )
 
-            if stock_data["quantity"] <= 0:
+            if stock_data["quantity"] <= 0 or (
+                stock_data["quantity"] - stock.quantity_allocated <= 0
+            ):
